Uncertainty — Owner’s Manual

STANDING ORDERS AND OPERATIONAL REGULATIONS Private Vessel UNCERTAINTY (Formerly HCS Surety, Registry No. CS-1147 — Crown markings removed)

Issued upon transfer of command. To be retained aboard at all times.

Commanding Officer: Delmar Fisk, Captain

Article I — Vessel Particulars

The Uncertainty is a Tier 1 patrol cutter, refitted for private independent operation. Her two cannon are sufficient to discourage uncooperative traffic and adequate for boarding-range combat. She is fast, draws little water, and carries a ram bow fitted at La Vasca. She may be taken through reef passages and canal approaches that would strand anything larger — including the Crown vessels she was built alongside.

Vessel Statistics

ParticularsSpecification
ClassificationPatrol cutter, Tier 1 (private)
Hull Integrity130 points
Hull AC11 (13 against head-on strikes)
Rate of Passage — favourable wind70 miles/day
Rate of Passage — poor wind30 miles/day
Rate of Passage — calm, oars deployed15 miles/day

Ordnance2 × 6-lb cannon (port and starboard); 2 × swivel gun (bow, stern); Ram

ConditionPristine

On Hull Integrity and Armour Class. Hull Integrity functions as hit points. When it reaches zero, the vessel is sinking. Hull AC represents the difficulty of landing a meaningful strike against a ship-scale target. The forward hull has AC 13 against head-on strikes only — the reinforced bow from the ram fitting.

On Repairs. At-sea repair requires a skilled Carpenter aboard. During a short rest, the Carpenter makes an Intelligence (Carpenter’s Tools) DC 15 check; on a success, the vessel recovers 2d8 + proficiency bonus Hull Integrity. Mending Resin (2 doses in the carpenter’s locker) can repair 2d8 Hull HP over 8 hours without a roll; this does not repair structural damage. In port, repairs run 1 gp per Hull Point at 25 Hull Points per workday.

Article II — Special Modifications

Ram Bow

The forward hull has been rebuilt with doubled planking, iron-pin cross-bracing, and an iron-capped ram plate.

Ram Attack. Helmsman’s action. The ship must move at least 20 feet in a straight line before the strike. Both ships take 2d10 bludgeoning damage; the Uncertainty takes half (rounded down) due to the reinforced bow. A target of Tier 1 or smaller must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be pushed 15 feet and have its next turn’s movement halved.

The ram is not subtle. Anyone watching the approach sees the intent before contact.

Shallow Draft

The keel depth has been reduced by 18 inches.

Shallow Draft. The Uncertainty can operate in water as shallow as 4 feet (standard patrol cutter minimum: ~8 ft). This opens river mouths, tidal flats, lagoon approaches, and Calveno’s inner canal network. The helmsman has advantage on Dexterity checks to navigate reef channels and shallow coastal passages. Trade-off: Speed in poor wind is 30 miles/day instead of 35.

Article III — Deck Arrangement

Weather Deck. Open upper deck. Bow swivel gun with 360° arc. Two 6-lb cannon amidships, one per side. Ram plate at the waterline forward. Quarterdeck is raised two feet at the stern; attacks from it against deck-level targets have advantage, and ascending costs an additional five feet of movement. Rigging may be climbed with a DC 10 Athletics check as an action. The mainmast boom may be swung as an improvised weapon (DC 12 Strength check): DC 13 Dexterity save or 1d8 bludgeoning and pushed ten feet.

Gun Deck. Interior living space, ~6’4” overhead. Crew quarters forward, galley hatch, Weapons Locker amidships, chart table, Surgeon’s Berth, crew mess aft. The Weapons Locker may be accessed as a bonus action. Signal lantern partner unit stowed near the chart table.

Hold. Galley (cast-iron stove) directly below crew mess, connected by iron ladder. Provisions Store occupying the former brig space. Powder magazine aft.

Full deck-by-deck dimensions and tactical notes: Deck Layouts.

Article IV — Ship’s Company

Each role below must be filled for the vessel to operate at standard. A role may be filled by a crew member or a hired professional. An unfilled role cannot perform its function or does so at disadvantage.

On minimum complement. The Uncertainty requires a minimum of four souls to operate. Below that number, all ship-related checks are made with disadvantage and rate of passage is reduced by twenty percent.

Roles and Rates of Pay

RoleFunctionKey AbilityRateActions While in Role
CaptainStrategic command — where to sail, what to target, when to fight or run. Final authority in action.Charisma—Action: Rallying Order — one creature within 60 ft gains advantage on their next check or attack before the start of your next turn.
QuartermasterCrew welfare, discipline, stores management, internal order. Senior to the Bosun.Charisma10 gp/wkAction: Crew’s Voice — one ally rerolls any failed check, attack, or save. Reaction: Fair Witness — crew member within 60 ft rolls death save or Frightened save with advantage.
NavigatorCourse-plotting, reef avoidance, Maw crossingIntelligence (Navigator’s Tools)10 gp/wkAction: Navigation check (see Article V). Reaction: Hazard Warning — declare before a navigation check; vessel rolls with advantage.
BosunRigging, sails, deck crew managementStr or Dex8 gp/wkAction: Trim Sails — DC 10 Dex; success grants helmsman one extra band this turn. Reaction: Brace! — one creature aboard halves damage from a ram or collision.
GunnerOrdnance direction and maintenanceDexterity8 gp/wkAction: Salvo, Aimed Shot, or Reload (see Article VII).
CarpenterHull repair, damage controlIntelligence (Carpenter’s Tools)6 gp/wkAction: Emergency Repair (Article I). Bonus Action: Plug the Breach — DC 10 Int (Carpenter’s Tools); success stops fire spread for one round.
CookProvisions management and crew sustenanceWisdom4 gp/wkNo combat action. Each crew member recovers an additional 1d6 HP on a long rest.
SurgeonTreatment of wounds and casualtiesWisdom (Medicine)8 gp/wkAction: Stabilize one incapacitated creature (DC 10 Wis/Medicine) or restore 1d6 + 4 HP (expends one Healer’s Kit use). Bonus Action: Field Triage — DC 10 Wis (Medicine); success gives one creature advantage on their next death save.
MarineBoarding actions, armed watch, vessel securityStr or Dex14 gp/wkAction: Attack, Grapple, or Shove. Bonus Action: Hold the Rail — one boarding enemy makes DC 13 Athletics or is shoved back.
Ordinary SailorAll other duties—2 gp/wkAction: Help — grant one creature advantage on their next check or attack this round.

Required always: Captain, Bosun. Required for open-water passages: Navigator. Required when ordnance is employed: Gunner. Required for at-sea repair: Carpenter. Required on voyages exceeding three days: Cook. Required to operate the Surgeon’s Berth: Surgeon. Required for boarding operations: Marine.

Current gaps: Navigator (partially covered by Crissdalynn on known routes), Cook, Surgeon. Oleandro at Ponte Bassa can direct you to available crew in Calveno.

Article VI — Passage and Navigation

ConditionsDC
Familiar or charted waters, clear weather10
Unfamiliar waters, reef approaches, poor visibility14
Maw approaches, active storm, uncharted shallows18

On a success, the passage proceeds without incident. On a failure, the voyage is delayed and complications arise. The Uncertainty’s navigational chart set covers the Crown Islands and Central Strait — coverage is good. Within five miles of the Drowned Maw, standard compasses fail; celestial navigation remains unaffected.

Shallow draft advantage. The helmsman has advantage on Dexterity checks to navigate reef channels and shallow coastal passages.

On long rests at sea. Standard rules apply. If the Cook role is filled, each character recovers an additional 1d6 HP. If a storm strikes during the rest period, each character makes a DC 12 Constitution save; failure means the rest confers no benefit.

Article VII — Action Against Hostile Vessels

Ships act in initiative order as creatures do.

Range Bands

BandDescriptionWhat’s Possible
BoardingShips alongside, locked, or grappledCrew can board. Cannon hit automatically — no attack roll. Swivels effective.
CannonStandard engagement distanceNormal cannon fire. Swivels cannot reach.
DistantExtreme rangeCannon fire at disadvantage. Swivels cannot reach.

The helmsman uses their Action to move the vessel one band. Dash moves an additional band. When both vessels have been Distant for two consecutive rounds, the quarry escapes.

Ramming

Helmsman’s action at Boarding range (see Article II — Ram Bow for full mechanics). Both vessels halt upon impact; the ramming vessel may not use the Helm action until the start of its next turn.

Ordnance Statistics

OrdnanceDamageNotes
6-lb cannond8 hull damageEffective at Cannon and Boarding range
Swivel gund6 crew damageBoarding range only; cannot damage hull

Attack roll: Dexterity + proficiency vs. target Hull AC. Hit: roll damage. Miss: half damage. Critical hit: maximum damage.

Gunner’s Actions

Salvo. All guns bearing on the target fire simultaneously. One attack roll vs. Hull AC. Hit: full damage from all guns on that side. Miss: half damage. All fired guns must reload before the next Salvo.

Aimed Shot. One gun at −2 to the attack roll. On a hit, the targeted component is disabled rather than dealing standard hull damage. That gun must reload before firing again.

Reload — All Guns. All guns reload in parallel. No attack is made this round.

Shot Types

Shot TypeEffect — HitEffect — MissNotes
Round ShotFull hull damageHalf hull damageStandard; always available
Chain ShotSpeed drops one band. Three reductions = dead in the water.Half reductionUse to slow a fleeing vessel or set up boarding
GrapeshotAll exposed deck crew: DC 14 Dex or incapacitated; PCs take 2d6 (save halves)PCs save with advantageBoarding range only; cannot damage hull

Any PC aware of incoming grapeshot may drop below deck as a Reaction before it lands.

Article VIII — Ship’s Facilities and Weekly Management

Each week, the Officer Complement conducts a Facility Review. All special facilities are assigned an order.

FacilityStatusFunction
Weapons LockerCommissionedUpgrades defender dice from d6 to d8 while stocked. Trade order: buy or sell arms at volume.
Surgeon’s BerthCommissioned (needs Surgeon hireling)Once per weekly review: stabilize all incapacitated crew; remove one disease or poison over eight hours; or cast Lesser Restoration without expending a spell slot.
Provisions StoreCommissionedHarvest order: produces rations, Healer’s Kits, Healing Potions, or antitoxin each week.
Chart Archive—Upgrade option. Replaces Provisions Store if installed. Research order: yields three pieces of intelligence.

Weekly Facility Orders

OrderEffect
CraftProduce items or magical items permitted by the facility.
EmpowerTrigger the facility’s active operational effect.
HarvestCollect facility outputs — potions, rations, poisons, materials.
MaintainNo directed activity. A facility event may occur.
RecruitEngage hirelings, Defenders, or specialist personnel.
ResearchGather intelligence, lore, or item identification.
TradeGenerate income via commerce.

Any facility that goes three consecutive weeks without orders goes dormant — hirelings have found other employment. Reactivating a dormant facility costs 100 gp and one week in port.

On Defenders

Defenders are the vessel’s hired security — enlisted via a Recruit order to the Crew Berths. They absorb hostile action events when the Officer Complement is absent. A single Recruit order enlists up to twelve. Keep them recruited.

Article IX — Vessel Standing and Port Records

The Uncertainty carries no flag and no identifiable marking. She reads as a private working coastal vessel at a glance. She does not read that way to a Dravosi naval officer who has served on this class of vessel.

StandingPractical Effect
RespectedReduced berthing fees; willing hirelings; faction contacts accessible.
KnownTreated according to actual conduct. Neutral default.
WantedPort access restricted or denied; bounties registered.
NotoriousCapable crew seek the vessel out; some quarries surrender rather than engage.

The Uncertainty’s prior Crown registration is an active liability. See DM Guide for the Crown recognition timeline.
